local_inferences: Polynomial-time polynomial-workspace decoding after retained pins is not a credible new mechanism, even for growing multiplicity.

A polynomial with a nonzero highest derivative coefficient need not have a regular base-field point in the high-degree regime.
The existing highest-degree coefficient argument avoids that unsupported regular-point premise.
